# Italian ArtVentures

> > Italian ArtVentures offers private guided tours and skip-the-line experiences across Italy's most iconic destinations including Rome's Colosseum and Vatican, Naples, Amalfi Coast, and Sicily.

Specializing in archaeological sites, ancient Roman landmarks, and cultural experiences, Italian ArtVentures provides expert-led private tours with hotel pickup, arena floor access, and underground Colosseum experiences. The company also offers shore excursions for cruise passengers and educational content about Italian history, art, and cuisine.

## Key Topics

- Colosseum underground tours
- Skip-the-line access
- Ancient Rome
- Roman Forum & Palatine Hill
- Vatican Museums
- Amalfi Coast excursions
- Naples private tours
- Archaeological sites
- Shore excursions for cruise passengers
- Arena floor access
- Vestal Virgins & Temple of Vesta
- Roman Empire history
- Day trips from Rome
- Traditional Italian cuisine
- Winter travel in Italy

## Featured Private Tours

- [Underground Colosseum Tour with Arena](https://www.italianartventures.com/tour/underground-colosseum-tour): Skip-the-line Colosseum Underground & Arena tour with hotel pickup
- [VIP Amalfi Coast Private Tour for Cruise Passengers](https://www.italianartventures.com/tour/vip-amalfi-coast-private-tour-for-cruise-passengers): Amalfi Coast shore excursion: Positano & Ravello from Naples port
- [Naples Tour](https://www.italianartventures.com/tour/naples-tour): Naples walking tour with Sansevero Chapel, Spaccanapoli & sfogliatella
- [Best of Taormina Tour](https://www.italianartventures.com/tour/best-of-taormina-tour): Taormina Sicily tour: Ancient Theater & Mount Etna views

## Ancient Roman Sites & History

- [A guide to the House of Vestal Virgins](https://www.italianartventures.com/vestal-virgins): House of Vestal Virgins & Temple of Vesta in Roman Forum guide
- [The Mausoleum of Augustus in Rome](https://www.italianartventures.com/mausoleum-of-augustus): Mausoleum of Augustus restoration, reopening info & visitor tickets
- [10 Must-See Highlights in the Capitoline Museum](https://www.italianartventures.com/10-must-see-highlights-in-the-capitoline-museum): Guide to Rome's oldest museum featuring Capitoline Wolf & Marcus Aurelius
- [Discover the Roman Amphitheater in Lucca](https://www.italianartventures.com/roman-amphitheater-in-lucca): Hidden Roman amphitheater in Lucca's Piazza Anfiteatro
- [Explore the Wonders of Paestum](https://www.italianartventures.com/explore-the-wonders-of-paestum): Ancient Greek temples at Paestum in Campania near Amalfi Coast
